sentence: This project develops respiration biosignal feedback for a digital mindfulness meditation trainer to help young adults understand how they build mindfulness skills.
This project tries to make extracellular vesicles gather and stay longer in the injured heart to help heart attack recovery without surgery.
This project studies how host, pathogen, and microbiome interactions in serious pneumonia lead to unsuccessful response to therapy.
This project builds a knowledgebase of chemical correlations in exposomics datasets, with online portals to explore and interpret them.
This project works on unmet needs in medical imaging technology related to normal and pathophysiological functions.
This project tries to find out why people with multiple sclerosis do not engage with mindfulness practice for chronic pain.
This project studies how a memory circuit in the entorhinal cortex helps form and retrieve associative memory.
This project builds machine learning models and tools that help vision researchers understand how the brain recognizes objects and faces.
This project studies how parts of the prefrontal cortex work together in effortful decision making, using intracranial recordings and direct cortical stimulation in humans.
This project studies how chromatin remodeling shapes the development and immune response of alveolar macrophages during respiratory infections.
This project uses artificial intelligence to help read preimplantation kidney biopsies and to predict outcomes after kidney transplant.
This project builds a non-invasive system that uses focused microwaves to heat brain tumors while monitoring temperature in real time.
This project studies how group 3 innate lymphoid cells use key enzymes to control gut physiology, including in inflammatory bowel disease.
This project builds tools, techniques, and protocols that bring immunologists and engineers together to improve immune-based therapies.
This project studies how a neuronal receptor complex lets amyloid damage synapses and cause cell death in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies the viral and host factors that decide the outcome of viral myocarditis in a model of neonatal myocarditis.
This project studies how much engineered cellular immune therapies differ from patient to patient in how well they work.
This project works on moving discoveries in cancer nanotechnology into the clinic.
This project studies memory problems in patients with temporal lobe lesions and epilepsy, including trouble with scene visualization and episodic memory.
